title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: Every service line on 8 CARFAX reports, read one by one. Ranked by how the car has lived, not by price.
facts: 6 cars with an engine, gearbox or electrical repair
takeaway: McLaren Chicago, the only clean car, sold Oct 31. Bentley is now the best history left; Marino is the best price at $138,000 out the door.
shift: Deal made earlier in the week, Jake confirmed Oct 31
No major repairs, but no service in 11 years: PPI decides
Out the door with transport, month-end counter
sources: Full CARFAX reports pulled from carfax.com and Autotrader dealer links on Oct 31, 2026 (Marino: the PDF the dealer sent Oct 30), Bentley repair order, dealer listings and CarGurus days on market. CARFAX shows only what shops report. Chicago Motor Cars has no public CARFAX.

cars.name: Bentley Jacksonville
cars.rep: Evap leak code (P0442) cleared, not traced: tank-top parts unchecked. Cracked filler neck cover and 4 wheels repaired.
tl: First service on record, Pegasus Exotic (independent)

Evap leak code cleared, not traced. Filler neck passed smoke test; canister, purge valve and leak pump sit on the tank and weren't checked. Light stayed off 4 drive cycles. Filler neck cover and 4 wheels repaired
cars.verdict: Nothing broke on paper, but nothing was serviced either. Clean or neglected: only a PPI tells you.

cars.name: Marino Performance
cars.rep: Engine front cover gasket + oil pressure sender, airbag assembly, wheel, rear brake pads on a new car.
tl: Dealer demo. Rear brake pads and a wheel replaced before the first sale
Owner 2, Florida, about 1,800 mi a year
Right airbag assembly replaced; extended warranty bought twice
Engine front cover gasket and oil pressure sender replaced (oil leak), ~11.7k mi
Owner 4 leases it 9 months, back at Marino
cars.verdict: Serviced often, but it had an engine oil-leak repair and two owners left inside 16 months. Stays evidence only.

cars.name: Exotic Knights
cars.rep: Door lock at 1k mi, new keys, engine mounts twice, wheel bearings, 3 tire sets by 11k mi.
tl: Door lock replaced, A/C checked, inside the first 1,000 mi
New keys cut and programmed, more tires
4 dealers in 4 weeks (Denver, Walser, Wichita, Charlotte), duplicate title
Engine mounts replaced again 30 mi later, wheel bearings serviced
cars.verdict: You called it. Fixes from year one, then the engine mounts done twice in 30 miles. Pass.

cars.name: Cascadia Collection
cars.rep: Electrical saga (computer, battery, intercooler, no-start, body electrical twice), wheel, windshield, accumulators.
tl: McLaren Philadelphia demo, then a California owner
Transmission fluid changed twice in 12 days
Electrical, cooling, engine, gearbox checked; electrical again 2 weeks later
Owner 4 dumps it at auction (2nd) after 5½ months
cars.verdict: Cheapest for a reason. Price evidence only, unless the Fields invoices and a McLaren PPI clear the electrical trail.

cars.name: Tampa Auto Gallery
cars.rep: Turbocharger at ~11.3k mi, all 4 tires at 464 mi, wheel repaired.
tl: Two owners, zero service records for 3 years
cars.verdict: A turbo at 11k and 3 years with no service. Pass.

cars.name: McLaren of Charlotte
cars.rep: Transmission replaced Sep 2026, right airbag assembly 2019.
tl: Right airbag assembly replaced (same part as Marino: likely a factory campaign)
Back on their lot 7 months and 600 mi later
cars.verdict: The last buyer brought it back and the gearbox got replaced. Pass unless they show the invoice and warranty it.

cars.name: Arizona dealer
cars.rep: Knock sensors, gearbox output shaft seal, fuel tank out and back, clockspring, battery, keys, switch, pump, wheel, seat, console, trim.
tl: 17 dealer visits in 18 months on a lease with under 1,100 mi
Fuel tank removed and refitted, 2 tire sets in 7 weeks, seat repaired, airbag clockspring
Gearbox output shaft seal replaced (leak), console and trim
Two duplicate titles; owner 5 sold it within 2 months
cars.verdict: 13 repairs and two auctions. Closest thing to a lemon on the board. Pass.

cars.name: Chicago Motor Cars
cars.car: 2016 · Supernova Silver / Carbon Black, loaded carbon, lift, sport exhaust
cars.rep: No public CARFAX (dealer link is the paid report). Price cut from $179,800 to $169,800.
tl: Built with Tech Pack, sport exhaust, front lift, carbon air brake, sills, mirrors and spoiler
History unknown. 1,785 mi; CARFAX only as a paid report
cars.verdict: The spec Qazi wants (exterior carbon, lift, exhaust) at 1,785 miles. Worth a real look: get the CARFAX and service records from the dealer, then push from the $10k cut.

cars.name: McLaren Chicago
cars.rep: None. Only oil, brake fluid, filters, wipers and inspections.
tl: Sold new by Lake Forest Sportscars, Indiana owner
First service on record, 4 years after delivery
Owner 2 (Missouri). McLaren Chicago inspection, brakes, fluids
Yearly McLaren Chicago services, 5.6k to 8.9k mi
Trade-in. Dealer oil service and inspection for sale
cars.verdict: Sold. Jake says they made a deal earlier in the week and will tell us if it falls through. Still the only car with nothing replaced.
